ink_purchases_purchased_on_check.name: ink_purchases_purchased_on_check
ink_purchases_purchased_on_check.value: length(purchased_on)=10 AND date(purchased_on) IS NOT NULL AND date(purchased_on)=purchased_on

known_printers_mac_check.name: known_printers_mac_check
known_printers_mac_check.value: mac IS NULL OR (length(mac)=12 AND mac NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

paper_purchases_purchased_on_check.name: paper_purchases_purchased_on_check
paper_purchases_purchased_on_check.value: length(purchased_on)=10 AND date(purchased_on) IS NOT NULL AND date(purchased_on)=purchased_on

paper_purchases_quantity_check.name: paper_purchases_quantity_check
paper_purchases_quantity_check.value:
CASE WHEN length_um IS NULL THEN typeof(packs)='integer' AND packs > 0 AND typeof(sheets_per_pack)='integer' AND sheets_per_pack > 0
    ELSE packs IS NULL AND sheets_per_pack IS NULL AND typeof(length_um)='integer' AND length_um > 0 END

paper_stocks_height_um_check.name: paper_stocks_height_um_check
paper_stocks_height_um_check.value: CASE format WHEN 'sheet' THEN typeof(height_um)='integer' AND height_um > 0 ELSE height_um IS NULL AND deckle=0 END

printer_ink_mappings_effective_from_chec.name: printer_ink_mappings_effective_from_check
printer_ink_mappings_effective_from_chec.value: length(effective_from)=10 AND date(effective_from) IS NOT NULL AND date(effective_from)=effective_from

printer_ink_readings_channel_check.name: printer_ink_readings_channel_check
printer_ink_readings_channel_check.value: length(channel) BETWEEN 1 AND 16 AND channel NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_]*'

printer_ink_readings_level_check.name: printer_ink_readings_level_check
printer_ink_readings_level_check.value: level IS NULL OR level BETWEEN 0 AND 100

stock_write_offs_written_off_on_check.name: stock_write_offs_written_off_on_check
stock_write_offs_written_off_on_check.value: length(written_off_on)=10 AND date(written_off_on) IS NOT NULL AND date(written_off_on)=written_off_on

stock_write_offs_quantity_check.name: stock_write_offs_quantity_check
stock_write_offs_quantity_check.value: CASE all_remaining WHEN 1 THEN quantity IS NULL ELSE typeof(quantity)='integer' AND quantity > 0 END

job_details.name: job_details
job_details.definition:
SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.printer_id, j.source_record_id,
       j.first_seen_at, j.last_seen_at,
       o.job_name, o.job_owner, o.started_at_raw, o.completed_at_raw,
       o.completion_state, o.job_type, o.width_um, o.height_um, o.used_area_mm2,
       o.impressions, o.color_pages, o.monochrome_pages, o.duplex,
       m.source_media_id, r.english_name AS configured_paper_name,
       o.resolved_media_name AS paper_name_at_import,
       COALESCE(a.custom_paper_name, r.english_name, r.short_name,
                o.resolved_media_name) AS display_paper_name,
       COALESCE(a.hidden, 0) AS hidden, a.custom_paper_name,
       a.paper_stock_id AS stock_override_id, a.paper_id AS paper_override_id, a.notes,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM print_jobs other
                        WHERE other.printer_id=j.printer_id
                          AND other.source_record_id=j.source_record_id
                          AND other.id<>j.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS record_id_collision
FROM print_jobs j
JOIN job_observations o ON o.id=j.current_observation_id
LEFT JOIN media_configs m ON m.id=o.media_config_id
LEFT JOIN media_revisions r ON r.id=m.current_revision_id
LEFT JOIN job_annotations a ON a.job_id=j.id
